description:
Cross-venue perpetual futures positioning read for an asset from funding rates on Hyperliquid, dYdX v4, Paradex and Aevo: crowded long / long bias / neutral / short bias / crowded short, venues that list it, confidence. Free preview tier. The paid x402 routes add per-venue funding (8h %, APR) and open interest (/v1/lite), premium, 7-day funding history and carry (/v1/full) and a universe scan for funding extremes and spreads (/v1/scan). Read-only analytics; not financial advice.

[PerpRadar via YourAITools MCP Hub] Free tier: same as PerpRadar's own MCP server (call without payment and without tier). Paid: lite $0.005 / full $0.03 / funding $0.002 per call, with a credits key (Authorization: Bearer yatc_...) or x402 (USDC; the hub returns the payment terms). Failed tool calls aren't charged: credits are refunded automatically and x402 payments only settle on success.
